title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Fixture Data Sheet
content:
The fixtures of **Area and Security Lighting Rental** are cooperative-owned, photocell-controlled dusk-to-dawn lights. This data sheet gives, for each fixture, its input power, the energy assumed for it each month for the power cost adjustment, its annual burning hours and the height of the standard wood pole set for it.

## Fixture data

| Fixture | Input power, ballast included (watts) | Estimated energy per month (kWh) | Annual dusk-to-dawn burning hours | Standard wood pole height (feet) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | 40 | 14 | 4100 | 30 |
| LED 70W Area Light | 70 | 24 | 4100 | 30 |
| LED 110W Flood Light | 110 | 38 | 4100 | 35 |
| LED 150W Flood Light | 150 | 51 | 4100 | 35 |
| HPS 100W Security Light | 120 | 41 | 4100 | 30 |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | 298 | 102 | 4100 | 35 |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | 205 | 70 | 4100 | 30 |

## Definitions

- **Input power** is the power the whole fixture draws, including any ballast, in whole watts. For the two high-pressure sodium fixtures and the mercury vapor fixture the input power is higher than the lamp size in the fixture's name (120 watts for the HPS 100W, 298 watts for the HPS 250W, 205 watts for the Mercury Vapor 175W), because the ballast is counted; for the LED fixtures the two figures are the same.
- **Estimated energy per month** is the whole number of kWh per month assumed for the fixture when the power cost adjustment is billed on the light.
- **Annual dusk-to-dawn burning hours** are the hours a photocell-controlled fixture burns in a year, 4100 for every fixture.
- **Standard wood pole height** is the height of the standard wood pole for the fixture: 30 feet for the LED 40W Security Light, the LED 70W Area Light, the HPS 100W Security Light and the Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light, and 35 feet for the LED 110W Flood Light, the LED 150W Flood Light and the HPS 250W Flood Light.
